definitions.explanation: A literary たる-adjective describing a state, result, or condition that is grim, devastating, or pitiable. Almost always appears in the prenominal form {惨憺|さんたん}たる or in the set compound {苦心|くしん}{惨憺|さんたん}.

examples.japanese: {惨憺|さんたん}たる⟦{結果|けっか}→結果：02486_kekka⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{終|お}わった→終わる：00567_owaru⟧。
examples.english: It ended in a disastrous result.

examples.japanese: ⟦{現場|げんば}→現場：02723_genba⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{惨憺|さんたん}たる{有様|ありさま}だった。
examples.english: The scene was a wretched sight.

examples.japanese: ⟦{苦心|くしん}→苦心：00255_kushin⟧{惨憺|さんたん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{末|すえ}→末：03362_sue⟧、ようやく⟦{完成|かんせい}→完成：01550_kansei⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧こぎつけた。
examples.english: After painstaking effort, we finally managed to complete it.

notes:
A literary たる-adjective derived from Classical Japanese. In modern usage it appears almost exclusively in the prenominal form {惨憺|さんたん}たる or in the fixed compound ⟦{苦心|くしん}→苦心：00255_kushin⟧{惨憺|さんたん}.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {惨憺|さんたん}たる⟦{結果|けっか}→結果：02486_kekka⟧: disastrous results
- {惨憺|さんたん}たる{有様|ありさま}: a wretched state
- {惨憺|さんたん}たる⟦{光景|こうけい}→光景：02799_koukei⟧: a grim scene
- ⟦{苦心|くしん}→苦心：00255_kushin⟧{惨憺|さんたん}: painstaking effort; toiling agonizingly

USAGE:
Never used as a plain predicate (×{惨憺|さんたん}だ is unnatural). Modern speakers use ⟦{悲惨|ひさん}→悲惨：12633_hisan⟧ or ⟦ひどい→ひどい：01097_hidoi⟧ in everyday conversation; {惨憺|さんたん} sounds formal or literary.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{悲惨|ひさん}→悲惨：12633_hisan⟧: tragic; miserable — much more common in everyday speech
- ⟦{惨|みじ}め→惨め：04851_mijime⟧: miserable; pitiful — focuses on personal humiliation
- ⟦ひどい→ひどい：01097_hidoi⟧: terrible; awful — colloquial, very general
